all_candidates.topic: Are government social media blocking orders excessive?
all_candidates.news_anchor: A report on August 18, 2026, revealed the government sent roughly one social media blocking order per minute from March to July.

all_candidates.topic: Should top e-commerce platforms face stricter complaint penalties?
all_candidates.news_anchor: A report to Lok Sabha on August 17, 2026, showed Flipkart, Amazon, and Meesho topping consumer grievances in 2025.

all_candidates.topic: Should fuel prices fluctuate with global crude prices?
all_candidates.news_anchor: India's petrol and diesel prices remained stable on August 18, 2026, despite rising global crude prices, due to state-run OMCs shielding consumers.

all_candidates.topic: Is the quick-commerce hygiene crackdown sufficient?
all_candidates.news_anchor: FSSAI and FDA initiated a nationwide crackdown on hygiene violations in quick-commerce dark stores and restaurants, reported on August 18, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should E10 petrol be reintroduced alongside E20?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Chief Economic Adviser V Anantha Nageswaran called for the reintroduction of lower ethanol blend petrol (E10) alongside E20 on August 17, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Is AI's net job creation truly beneficial for India's workforce?
all_candidates.news_anchor: A Nomura report, widely covered around August 7-11, 2026, stated AI-related hiring in India has outpaced layoffs but noted declining entry-level recruitment.

all_candidates.topic: Should companies prioritize entry-level hiring despite AI efficiency?
all_candidates.news_anchor: A Nomura report (August 7-11, 2026) highlighted that AI is creating a two-tiered job market with weaker demand for entry-level employees.

all_candidates.topic: Should food companies face harsher penalties for misleading labels?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Several food companies agreed to rectify misleading labels and re-formulate products following FSSAI crackdowns, reported on August 18, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should government compensate for E20 mileage dip and wear?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The central government acknowledged on July 30, 2026, that E20 petrol causes a 2-6% dip in vehicle mileage and can accelerate wear of rubber parts, sparking ongoing discussion.

all_candidates.topic: Should NEET be abolished based on TN Assembly's resolution?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Tamil Nadu Assembly unanimously adopted a resolution on August 11, 2026, urging the abolition of NEET for medical admissions.

all_candidates.topic: Are police excesses against NEET protesters justified?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Supreme Court is set to hear petitions on August 18, 2026, alleging police excesses against students protesting NEET paper leaks.

all_candidates.topic: Is FM's UPI no-charge clarity enough for consumers?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman clarified on August 11, 2026, that UPI transactions remain free for consumers, with future merchant charges limited to select high-value categories.

all_candidates.topic: Has GST rate rationalization truly benefited ordinary taxpayers?
all_candidates.news_anchor: An article on August 18, 2026, reviewed how recent GST rate rationalization has impacted taxpayer financial freedom.

all_candidates.topic: Are shorter social media content removal deadlines beneficial?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Centre reduced the deadline for social media platforms to remove unlawful/AI-generated content to 2-3 hours, as reported on August 13, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Are automakers justified in raising E20 fuel contamination concerns?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Internal communications among major automakers (Maruti Suzuki, Tata Motors, Mahindra) reviewed by Reuters on August 13, 2026, showed concerns about contamination of E20 petrol.

all_candidates.topic: Is criminalizing Vande Mataram insult necessary for national honour?
all_candidates.news_anchor: President Droupadi Murmu assented to a Bill on August 11, 2026, criminalizing intentional disruption or prevention of the singing of 'Vande Mataram'.

all_candidates.topic: Is reducing Kisan Credit Card interest subvention fair to farmers?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The government is discussing a 50 basis point reduction in interest subvention for Kisan Credit Card loans, reported on August 17, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Will cooperative ride-hailing truly empower drivers more?
all_candidates.news_anchor: India's first cooperative-based ride-hailing platform, 'Bharat Taxi,' was launched, offering a zero-commission model, as reported on August 17, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should 'Right to Walk' mandate significant infrastructure investment?
all_candidates.news_anchor: An article on August 10, 2026, discussed how the Supreme Court's June 2026 'Right to Walk' ruling needs to translate into tangible urban infrastructure.

all_candidates.topic: Should all AI-generated content require mandatory labels?
all_candidates.news_anchor: New IT Rules, highlighted on August 13, 2026, require mandatory labeling and metadata for all synthetic (AI-generated) content.
